name.zh-CN: CAD 导出与质量检查；语义拓扑角色及来源诊断
name.en: CAD Export Validation; Semantic Topology Provenance

description: Independently inspect actual SVG/DXF output from one validated DrawingModel and formal STEP output after re-import/equivalence, including orthographic and section evidence, countersink cones, explicit pattern instances, units, dimensions, and model identity. and planar fixed-section Sweep geometry using STEP re-import, analytic surface signatures, independent bounds/mass, and path/profile material witnesses. For Loft STEP, require the canonical manufacturing path, re-import, equivalence and material probes at each declared section station. Compare SVG and DXF independently and record the sampling and STEP tolerances. G7C: reference generated topology only within fixed-binormal planar Line/Arc Sweeps and aligned ruled Lofts; Hole uses caps only, while Fillet/Chamfer uses an explicit intersection of generated face roles. Preserve source Feature, role, and Sketch entity/adjacent ordered-section IDs; never persist OCP Face/Edge ordinals. Re-resolve with tolerances after rebuild and fail closed on zero or multiple matches.
trigger: a formal drawing export is produced
execution_steps: Check SVG root and distinct formal view groups
Check DXF HEADER millimeter units and nonempty ENTITIES section
Check both artifacts share the formal DrawingModel report and current model fingerprint
Check that Front, Top, and Left exports were generated from the same current rebuilt EngineeringModel fingerprint
Confirm Front, Top, and Left reflect the same final treated-body fingerprint, including valid derived ellipse or cone evidence when returned by OCP.

For revolved output, check axial circles, stepped side contours, and any bounded approximation tolerance reported by formal HLR evidence; compare SVG and DXF independently against the same current DrawingModel.
For Section A-A, independently verify the SVG section_aa view and material hatch group, and verify DXF millimetre units, section label, and AICAD_HATCH entities when hatching is present.
Check section boundary-loop count, sampled chord tolerance, and section provenance against the DrawingModel report; do not substitute a model response or preview for the exported files.
For each resolved associative dimension, compare formal DrawingModel value/reference/layout with actual SVG and DXF visual output.
Report DXF_VISUAL_ANNOTATION separately from DXF_NATIVE_DIMENSION; inspect actual DXF entity types and never call TEXT/LINE output a native DIMENSION.
Confirm each artifact corresponds to the same current rebuild digest and DrawingModel.
For Countersink STEP evidence, independently inspect re-imported conical surface angle, mouth/main radii, axis, location, and material-removal witness against EngineeringModel values.
For ExplicitPlacementPattern, compare re-imported cut axes/centres and count to each declared local U/V placement transformed through the typed reference plane.

For Sweep STEP evidence, compare re-imported analytic curved-edge/surface signatures and material probes derived from profile points at declared Path stations against the validated source; retain existing tolerances and fail closed if witnesses differ.
Confirm the formal STEP section witnesses correspond to each ordered Sketch and no Drawing runtime Shape bypasses the canonical exporter.
For a generated Sweep/Loft reference, capture the source Feature, semantic face role, Sketch entity identity, or adjacent ordered Loft section pair from the EngineeringModel.
validation_gates: SVG and DXF receive independent results
DXF geometry is not inferred from SVG appearance
Do not mark exports as validated when any required artifact check fails
Do not infer Hole geometry or pattern completion from SVG/DXF file presence alone
Do not infer Fillet/Chamfer success from a model reply or export file alone; require the validated final Feature History and DrawingModel evidence.
Do not infer successful Revolve geometry from projected appearance alone; require a valid final B-Rep rebuild and matching formal view/export evidence.
A section hatch export is valid only when it comes from typed Section A-A material geometry and remains in bounds in the target format.
SVG and DXF are checked independently; matching view names do not prove their geometry or annotations match.
SVG/DXF visual markup is not proof of native DXF DIMENSION support.
The current visual-only DXF exporter remains DXF_NATIVE_DIMENSION=DEFERRED until a real DIMENSION entity and its measurements/style are parsed and verified.
STEP file existence or nonzero size is insufficient; Countersink and every ExplicitPlacementPattern instance require re-imported geometric evidence and equivalence.
Drawing geometry does not prove that a countersink angle/diameter annotation is present.

A Sweep STEP is valid only after canonical formal manufacturing, one-solid checks, re-import, equivalence, and EngineeringModel-derived path/profile witnesses; do not use Drawing runtime geometry as the STEP source.
Any Loft claim requires actual ordered section references and the validated current EngineeringModel rebuild; never infer unsupported topology or hidden section size.
Generated face and edge roles re-resolve against current source geometry with explicit tolerances; zero or multiple matches fail closed, with no persisted OCP ordinals.
failure_policy: Keep downloads disabled for an invalid current artifact
Never substitute a preview image for a CAD export
On stale, missing, ambiguous, or unsupported topology, preserve the original error code and stop; never retarget by face/edge order.
G7C：在固定 binormal 的平面 Line/Arc Sweep 与 aligned ruled Loft 范围内引用生成拓扑；Hole 仅使用端盖，Fillet/Chamfer 使用明确的生成面交线。所有引用保留来源 Feature、角色及草图实体/相邻有序截面 ID，不保存 OCP Face/Edge 编号；上游重建后按公差重解析，零匹配或多匹配必须失败关闭。
